answer: I have successfully configured the system to minimize the 'Dim screen when inactive' behavior. The Screen Blank setting has been changed to 12 minutes, which is the maximum available time interval in this system. This setting controls when the screen turns off after a period of inactivity. Since there is no "Never" option available in this system, 12 minutes is the longest delay possible to prevent the screen from automatically blanking. Additionally, Automatic Suspend is set to Off, which prevents the computer from going to sleep. This configuration effectively minimizes the screen dimming/blanking behavior when the system is inactive.
